{{Top|leg}}
The '''Republic Agricultural Administration''' was an agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that oversaw the development of agriculture and the production of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]]. Throughout its history, the organization worked closely with the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>
